units.source_text: 弁君把薰中纳言的心思与言语转告二女公子，悲哀之情越发难于自慰了。

en.t: Ben no Kimi conveyed Kaoru Chunagon's thoughts and words to the Second Princess, and her sorrow became still harder to console.

units.source_text: 众侍女个个得意扬扬，忙于缝制衣饰。

en.t: All the waiting women were in high spirits, busy sewing and preparing garments.

units.source_text: 几个年老的侍女也忘记了自己的丑颜，这样那样地打扮，使弁君显得更憔悴了。

en.t: Even several elderly attendants forgot their own plain looks and dressed themselves up in various ways, which made Ben no Kimi appear even more worn and sorrowful.
